summary: Describes how to provide call transfer in SIP using extensions such as REFER and Replaces, covering blind, consultative and attended transfer. It is part of the SIP multiparty call control framework, and is a Best Current Practice.

eli5.summary: When a receptionist moves your call to a colleague, a transfer happens. This document explains the exact steps phones take to do it, whether the receptionist talks first or not.

questions: how does sip call transfer work
